dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I don't know if the thought of the battles ahead is troubling you, but... If so, I do have one suggestion to make.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: We should make sure we're well-rested before we proceed! We could find a safe spot to have an afternoon nap, for example.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I, um... I always strive to do things perfectly, but so often I find that the harder I push myself, the more mistakes I end up making.
